summary: A Yes vote enacts a temporary half-cent sales tax in the City of Oceanside to fund public safety and infrastructure, with citizen oversight and independent auditing.

tax.text: A Yes vote increases the city’s sales tax by one-half cent to fund city projects and services.
tax.quote: Measure S, a temporary half-cent sales tax increase that would boost the city’s current rate of 8.25% to 8.75%

tax.text: A No vote does not increase the city’s sales tax through Measure S.
